messages:
Ana Park: Quick sync — want to lock the SI onboarding practicals for Q3, especially shadow labs + certification paths for Cloud Marketplace & HW partners. What does success look like?
Jordan Li: Love this. Proposed pillars: 1) hands-on shadow lab, 2) playbook + runbook, 3) tiered badge/cert, 4) marketplace listing enablement. Need acceptance criteria for each.
Mike O'Neill: +1. Suggest three cohort tracks: Cloud MSPs, Hardware Integrators, SI Generalists. Different lab stacks for each. Cloud MSPs need marketplace publishing checklist; HW integrators need rack access + firmware/driver validation.
Leila Torres: I can pull vendor contacts at NovaHW and RackCloud to get early access. Also recommend an automated scoring rubric (pass/fail + silver/gold platinum badges).
Ana Park: Rubric good. We should include eval prompts for perf and cost SLOs. Example infra test: run a 8k-context generation replay, measure p99 latency and token cost — baseline targets attached below.
Jordan Li: Quick: do we require Redwood Private for cert or allow Redwood Dedicated? Dedicated makes it easier to standardize.
Mike O'Neill: Prefer Dedicated for reproducibility, but HW partners may need Private/on-prem runs. So allow either but document clear infra matrix (GPU SKU, quantization profile, model variant).
Simon K.: I can host the first pilot cohort the week of Aug 7. I can run 4 labs: embeddings at scale, chat failover, batch inference, and marketplace publish flow.
ci-bot: deploy-bot: workbook uploaded: si-onboard-lab-v1 -> https://internal.redwood.dev/workbooks/si-onboard-lab-v1 :information_source:
Leila Torres: I'll draft partner T&Cs + NDA checklist — need vendor contacts from Mike & Simon.
Ana Park: Draft checklist (quick):
```
- Pre-reqs: Redwood creds, Dedicated cluster access or Private image, partner HW rack IPs
- Lab 1: Embeddings scale test (script: `scripts/embeddings_loadtest.sh`)
- Lab 2: Chat with stateful context (8k) — run `python run_chat_eval.py --context 8000`
- Lab 3: Batch reranking throughput benchmark (`./bench/rerank --qps 200`)
- Acceptance: p99 latency < 250ms on Dedicated (8k, small model), cost per 1k tokens delta <= X% vs baseline
- Certification: pass all labs OR pass + remediation plan within 2 weeks
```
Jordan Li: Also include a short evaluation rubric matrix: technical (50%), operational docs (20%), marketplace listing readiness (15%), partner enablement plan (15%).
Mike O'Neill: I'll assemble infra matrix and sample AMI/container images. Also propose a short training video (15 min) for onboarding SIs to the Redwood Console routes for rollouts & fallback policies.
Simon K.: Confirmed — I'll schedule pilot labs + sign ups. I recommend 8 SI slots for pilot (2 per lab rotation).
Leila Torres: Timeline ask: need vendor NDAs and access by Jul 24 to prep images. Can anyone confirm?
Ana Park: Next steps: Simon to schedule pilot, Leila to confirm vendor access/NDAs, Jordan to draft cert rubric doc by Fri, Mike to assemble infra matrix. I'll add this to the partnership roadmap and ping the SI cohort after pilot. :rocket:
Mike O'Neill: Ack.
Jordan Li: Will draft rubric, adding measurable thresholds.
Simon K.: I'll send calendar invites and a short sign-up form.
Leila Torres: On it — will chase NovaHW contact. :+1:
Ana Park: Thanks all — let's keep the pilot tight and iterate. :thumbsup:
